comment: Scrub - records the last 7.9 seconds and lets you move through them with a knob; where you stop, a grain of sound keeps looping (a freeze). Pos = where the read head is in the last 6 s, 10 ms per step, 0 = 6 s ago, 600 = now; turning it slides through the audio at the original pitch, stopping freezes the grain there. Grain = length of the looping grain (10 ms buzz to 1 s loop, or a note value synced to the pedal's tempo: MIDI clock, tap or patch TEMPO; tap button on Grain); Rec = LIVE (keeps recording: a delay you can sweep), HOLD (stops recording: scrub and freeze the last 6 s), STOMP (records while the effect is off, freezes when you switch it on; untested); Glide = how slowly the head follows Pos; Dir = FWD, REV, PING (ping-pong) or RAND (random direction) grains; Spray = random offset per grain (+- ms), a cloud instead of a loop; Mix is a DJ-style dry/wet crossfade. No Tempo knob: a synced Grain follows the pedal's tempo and, while MIDI transport runs, locks to the clock; MIDI Start starts a new grain on the downbeat.
gid_comment: 0x08 = Delay category -> Fx_DLY_. Grouped under DLY with the rest of the pack.
fxid_comment: 480 DualShft, 485 DubSiren, 486 Choral, 487 WaveFold, 488 EuGate, 489 S.GN_L, 490 Scrub, 491 DirtBox, 493 Breather, 495 GridDly, 496 Sweep (this pack; 492 and 494 were used by dropped effects, 498 and 499 by the probes). Unique inside the repo; check other community effects.

params.name: Pos
params.comment: Where the read head is in the last 6 seconds, 10 ms per step: 0 = 6 s ago, 600 = now (in HOLD: the moment you froze). Shown as how far back the head is (0ms, 990ms, 4.50s). Turn it to scrub; stop and the grain there loops. Default 600 = now.

params.name: Grain
params.comment: Length of the looping grain. 0..100 = free, 10 ms to 1 s (log), shown in ms: short = a buzzing tone made of the sound, long = a loop of a whole hit or chord. 101..112 = synced to the pedal's tempo (MIDI clock, tap or patch TEMPO; 120 BPM on stock firmware), shown as a note value: 1/64, 1/32, 1/16T, 1/16, 1/8T, 1/16., 1/8, 1/4T, 1/8., 1/4, 1/4., 1/2, so the freeze loops in time; while MIDI transport runs the loop locks to the clock and MIDI Start restarts it on the downbeat. Long grains pull the head in so they still fit in the buffer (a synced grain over about 1 s; with REV, PING or RAND in LIVE any grain over about 0.6 s); one too long to fit even at 0ms is shortened. Default 50 = 100 ms.

params.name: Rec
params.comment: LIVE = the buffer keeps recording, Pos is how far back you listen (a delay you can sweep). HOLD = recording stops, Pos scrubs through the last 6 of the 7.9 seconds kept. STOMP = records while the effect is switched off, freezes the moment you switch it on (untested on the pedal). Default LIVE.

params.name: Glide
params.comment: How slowly the head follows Pos. 0 = jumps straight there, 40 = about 0.1 s, 70 = about 1 s, 100 = about 3 s: a slow glide. Default 40.

params.name: Dir
params.comment: Which way the grain plays. FWD = forward, REV = backward, PING = forward then backward in turns (ping-pong): the loop turns round on itself, so there is no jump at the seam. RAND = each grain flips a coin, forward or backward (random ping-pong). Default FWD.

params.name: Spray
params.comment: Random offset for each new grain, either side of the head, up to +-250 ms (never ahead of now). Shown as OFF, then +-1 .. +-250 (ms). 0 = the freeze is a steady loop, higher = a moving cloud around the head. Default 0.

params.name: Mix
params.comment: Dry/wet crossfade, DJ style: dry full from 0 to 50, wet full from 50 to 100, both full at 50. Default 50: you play over the frozen sound.

audio_nop_comment: Set true for a UI-only smoke build before trusting the DSP.
